facts.statement: For Spain's 29 November 2026 general election, eligible CERA voters sending their postal vote from abroad to their consular office must dispatch it no later than 24 November 2026.
facts.sourceTitle: Interior / La Moncloa — voting from abroad, 20 November 2026

facts.statement: Registered new residential rental contracts in Barcelona municipality fell from 51,294 in 2019 to 30,789 in 2025, a decrease of about 40.0% relative to 2019.
facts.sourceTitle: Generalitat de Catalunya — municipal rental-contract workbook

facts.statement: Tesla's first store in Argentina was inaugurated on 20 November 2026, as recorded in the official Casa Rosada launch address.
facts.sourceTitle: Casa Rosada — Tesla launch address, 20 November 2026

facts.statement: As of 21 November 2026, Atenea had published a November 2026 report titled 'Votar con criterio', presented as a voting guide for Spain's 29 November election.
facts.sourceTitle: Atenea — Votar con criterio, November 2026 edition

facts.statement: On 21 November 2026, Pedro Sánchez announced that the next Council of Ministers would extend the bank tax into 2027, projecting €1.4 billion in revenue to be allocated to housing policies.
En España, la EPA del tercer trimestre de 2026 estima 22.852.600 personas ocupadas de 16 o más años; son estimaciones de encuesta, no el número de afiliaciones a la Seguridad Social.
facts.statementEn: In Spain, the third-quarter 2026 Labour Force Survey (EPA) estimates 22,852,600 employed people aged 16 and over; these are survey estimates, not the number of Social Security registrations.

facts.statement: Según la nota del INE del 9 de octubre de 2026, en las elecciones generales españolas del 29 de noviembre de 2026 podrán votar 38.728.356 electores: 35.958.711 residentes en España y 2.769.645 residentes en el extranjero. Son cifras de electores, no de votos emitidos ni de participación.
facts.statementEn: According to the INE note of 9 October 2026, 38,728,356 voters are eligible in Spain's 29 November 2026 general election: 35,958,711 living in Spain and 2,769,645 living abroad. These are eligible voters, not votes cast or turnout.

facts.statement: A 21 de noviembre de 2026, RTVE anuncia un debate parlamentario con portavoces de ocho formaciones para el lunes 23 de noviembre a las 22:00, moderado por Xabier Fortes. Es un acontecimiento anunciado para una fecha futura respecto al corte.
facts.statementEn: As of 21 November 2026, RTVE has announced a parliamentary debate with spokespeople from eight parties for Monday 23 November at 22:00, moderated by Xabier Fortes. It is an event announced for a date after the cut-off.

facts.statement: Para las generales españolas del 29 de noviembre de 2026, el período ordinario de depósito presencial de voto CERA en embajadas, consulados o centros habilitados es del 21 al 26 de noviembre, ambos incluidos.
facts.statementEn: For Spain's 29 November 2026 general election, the ordinary period for CERA voters to cast their vote in person at embassies, consulates or designated centres runs from 21 to 26 November, inclusive.

facts.statement: El Ministerio de Inclusión registra en octubre de 2026 una afiliación media de 22.624.165 en la serie original de la Seguridad Social, 186.612 más que en septiembre y 784.573 más que en octubre de 2025. Es un registro administrativo y una media mensual; no la estimación trimestral de ocupados de la EPA.
facts.statementEn: The Ministry of Inclusion recorded average Social Security enrolment of 22,624,165 in October 2026 in the unadjusted series, 186,612 more than in September and 784,573 more than in October 2025. It is an administrative register and a monthly average, not the EPA quarterly estimate of employed people.

facts.statement: A 21 de noviembre de 2026, están convocadas en España elecciones al Congreso de los Diputados y al Senado para el domingo 29 de noviembre de 2026, mediante el Real Decreto 806/2026, de 5 de octubre.
facts.statementEn: As of 21 November 2026, elections to Spain's Congress of Deputies and Senate are called for Sunday 29 November 2026 by Royal Decree 806/2026 of 5 October.

facts.statement: El MIT italiano informó el 20 de noviembre de 2026 de que la Motorizzazione reconoció el día 19 para Italia la homologación provisional neerlandesa de Tesla Assisted Driving. Se trata de reconocimiento territorial de asistencia a la conducción, no de una autorización europea definitiva de conducción sin supervisión.
facts.statementEn: Italy's Ministry of Infrastructure and Transport (MIT) reported on 20 November 2026 that the Motorizzazione recognised in Italy, on the 19th, the Dutch provisional type approval of Tesla Assisted Driving. This is territorial recognition of driver assistance, not a final European authorisation for unsupervised driving.

facts.statement: En España, el IPC general de octubre de 2026 registró una variación interanual del 4,9%, según la nota del INE del 13 de noviembre. Es una tasa frente a octubre de 2025, no una caída de los precios ni el encarecimiento acumulado desde 2018.
facts.statementEn: In Spain, headline CPI rose 4.9% year on year in October 2026, according to the INE note of 13 November. It is a rate against October 2025, not a fall in prices or the cumulative increase since 2018.

facts.statement: El Índice de Precios de Vivienda del INE para España registró una variación interanual del 12,2% en el segundo trimestre de 2026. Mide precios de compraventa; no es una estadística de alquileres.
facts.statementEn: INE's House Price Index for Spain rose 12.2% year on year in the second quarter of 2026. It measures sale prices; it is not a rental statistic.

facts.statement: La Seguridad Social informa de una revalorización general del 2,7% en 2026 para las pensiones contributivas del sistema y las de Clases Pasivas, respecto al importe a 31 de diciembre de 2025. No es la previsión de subida para 2027.
facts.statementEn: Social Security reports a general 2.7% increase in 2026 for contributory pensions and Clases Pasivas pensions, relative to the amount at 31 December 2025. It is not the forecast increase for 2027.

facts.statement: Interior contabiliza provisionalmente 24.364 llegadas irregulares por vía marítima a Canarias del 1 de enero al 15 de noviembre de 2026, frente a 14.690 en el mismo período de 2025: 9.674 más, un 65,9%.
facts.statementEn: The Interior Ministry provisionally counts 24,364 irregular sea arrivals to the Canary Islands from 1 January to 15 November 2026, against 14,690 in the same period of 2025: 9,674 more, or 65.9%.

facts.statement: En las elecciones al Parlamento de Andalucía del 17 de mayo de 2026, el reparto publicado por la Junta Electoral de Andalucía fue: PP, 53; PSOE de Andalucía, 28; Vox, 15; Adelante Andalucía, 8; y Por Andalucía, 5, sobre 109 escaños. Son resultados del escrutinio general publicados oficialmente, no el avance provisional de la noche electoral.
facts.statementEn: In the Andalusian Parliament election of 17 May 2026, the seat allocation published by the Andalusian Electoral Board was: PP 53, PSOE de Andalucía 28, Vox 15, Adelante Andalucía 8 and Por Andalucía 5, out of 109 seats. These are the officially published results of the general count, not the provisional election-night tally.

facts.statement: La información vigente de la Seguridad Social para nacimientos, adopciones o acogimientos a partir del 31 de julio de 2025 establece un descanso total de 19 semanas para cada progenitor y 32 para familias monoparentales, sujeto a los requisitos de la prestación.
facts.statementEn: Current Social Security information for births, adoptions or foster placements from 31 July 2025 sets total leave of 19 weeks for each parent and 32 weeks for single-parent families, subject to the benefit's requirements.

facts.statement: On 17 November 2026, Spain's Council of Ministers set the 2027 minimum wage (SMI) at €1,286 a month in 14 payments, or €18,004 a year, from 1 January 2027. That is a 5.3% increase: €65 more a month and €910 more a year. The same day it approved an income tax deduction so that minimum-wage earners pay no IRPF.
facts.sourceTitle: La Moncloa — Council of Ministers press conference, 17 November 2026

facts.statement: Royal Decree-law 38/2026 of 17 November adds an income tax (IRPF) deduction of €1,033.58 so that minimum-wage earners, with income up to €18,004 a year, pay no IRPF from 2027 and have no monthly withholding. The deduction tapers to zero at €23,172; the government estimates 2.7 million taxpayers save €1.2 billion.
facts.sourceTitle: La Moncloa — Council of Ministers press conference, 17 November 2026

facts.statement: Spain's minimum wage was €735.90 a month in 14 payments in 2018, under Royal Decree 1077/2017. At €1,286 a month in 2027, it is about 74.7% higher than in 2018.
facts.sourceTitle: BOE — Royal Decree 1077/2017, minimum wage for 2018

facts.statement: Royal Decree-law 37/2026 of 17 November allows Spanish public-sector pay to rise by a maximum overall 4.5% in 2027, relative to pay at 31 December 2026, with effect from 1 January 2027.

On 17 November 2026, the Council of Ministers approved Royal Decree-law 38/2026, giving Spain's autonomous communities €185,593 million in 2027 (9.1% more than in 2026) and local authorities €33,773 million (11.5% more). The same decree adds an income tax deduction so that minimum-wage earners pay no IRPF from their first 2027 payslip.
facts.sourceTitle: La Moncloa — Council of Ministers reference, 17 November 2026

facts.statement: INE's Industry Turnover Index (ICN) rose 1.9% month on month in September 2026 after removing seasonal and calendar effects. The annual rate was 9.9% in the adjusted series and 11.7% in the original series (published 20 November 2026).

INE's Services Sector Activity Indicator (IASS) rose 1.9% month on month in September 2026 after removing seasonal and calendar effects. Annual turnover growth was 7.4% in the adjusted series and 8.5% in the original series (published 20 November 2026).
facts.sourceTitle: INE — Services Sector Activity Indicators, September 2026

facts.statement: INE's harmonised business demography counts 3,552,872 economically active companies in Spain in 2024: 334,789 were created and 269,592 closed, a net rate of 1.8%. 42.4% of companies born in 2019 survived five years (published 13 November 2026).

Royal Decree 126/2026 of 18 February set Spain's 2026 minimum wage (SMI) at €1,221 a month or €40.70 a day, with an annual floor of €17,094 in 14 payments, effective from 1 January 2026. That was a 3.1% increase on the 2025 figure of €1,184 a month.
facts.sourceTitle: BOE — Royal Decree 126/2026, minimum wage for 2026

facts.statement: In October 2026, Spain had 3,699,878 foreign workers registered with Social Security, 16.4% of the total. At the end of October, 490,586 registered foreign workers came from the extraordinary regularisation, led by people from Colombia (27.6%) and Venezuela (15.7%). Self-employed registrations passed 3.5 million (3,501,598) for the first time.
facts.sourceTitle: La Moncloa — Social Security registrations, October 2026

facts.statement: In early November 2026, the Labour Ministry's advisory committee on the minimum wage recommended raising it by 4.9% in 2027, from €1,221 to €1,281 a month in 14 payments. On 17 November 2026 the Government approved a larger rise of 5.3%, to €1,286.
facts.sourceTitle: El Derecho (Europa Press) — experts recommend a 4.9% minimum-wage rise, 4 November 2026
